description: Erection of a four-bedroom detached house in the rear of 81 Whitton Road with access from Lanigan Drive
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the dwellinghouse hereby permitted shall match those used on the adjoining pair of semi-detached dwellings directly to the north of the site.

Condition : 3 - Restrictions of permitted development rights

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any other revoking, re-enacting or modifying that Order):
a) no enlargement of the dwellinghouse or the erection of structures within the curtilage of the dwellinghouse shall take place forward of any wall of that dwellinghouse which fronts onto Lanigan Drive. 
b) no enlargement of the dwellinghouse by way of an extension to the rear of the existing outrigger to the rear of the dwelling shall take place.

Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the north and south elevations of the dwellinghouse hereby approved shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - All hard and soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.  The works shall be carried out prior to the occupation of any part of the development or in accordance with the programme agreed with the local planning authority
Condition : 6 - The building shall not be occupied until a means of vehicular access has been constructed in accordance with the approved plans.

Condition : 7 - Waste and Recycled Materials Storage

Before the dwellinghouse hereby approved is first occupied, the developer shall provide to the dwelling a green box container and any other type of containers required at the time of development for household use for the storage and collection of recyclable materials for the purposes of the Council's kerbside recycling service, to the specification then in use by the local authority's recycling collection service (or to such other specification as shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority) and shall notify the Council's refuse and recycling services when the development is first occupied.  The house shall also be supplied with a garden waste-composting bin of at least 220 litres capacity at the same time.

Condition : 8 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 9 - Use of Garage

The garage of the dwellinghouse hereby approved shall be kept permanently available for the parking of private vehicles.

Condition : 10 - Street lighting 
Prior to occupation of the development, the street lighting proposed on Lanigan Drive shall be implemented and maintained in perpetuity.

Condition : 11 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 12 - Construction Logistic Plan

No development shall take place until a Construction Logistic Plan (CLP) covering the construction stages has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The CLP shall cover: (i) Any external illumination of the site; (ii) Measures to ensure that all mud and other loose materials are not carried on the wheels and chassis of any vehicles leaving the site; (iii) Measures to minimise dust nuisance caused by the operations and to ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on to the adjoining properties; (iv) The routeing of vehicles to the site, access and egress arrangements and waiting areas; and (v) Boundary treatment and measures to ensure they are maintained in a secure and tidy condition.
